sense_groups.note: Distinguish a third-person pronoun from an explicitly named person; preserve names only when a name is stated.

variants.back_notes: Every ownership relation and name attribute must be present in the visible source. Preserve unspecified ownership as unspecified. Do not infer that a friend or sibling belongs to the speaker.
